ko   Sorting Designation: 2. 1 • rpn. que, ce que, quoi; what. Inan ko kalfinɗaa kam. Here is what you entrusted to me. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

2 • rpn. lequel; which. Huɗo ko kokkumi jawdi am nafii ndi sanne. L'herbe que j'ai donné aux animaux les aident beaucoup. The grass which I gave my animals helped them a lot. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

3 • conj. le fait que, parce que; that; because. Ko ɓe njaɓaay adude nyawɗo o maayii. Le fait qu'ils ont refusé de bouger la personne blessé a fait qu'elle est décédé. That/because they refused to move the injured person she died. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

4 • dpn. that; this. Huɗo ko na wooɗi sanne. This grass is very good. there are actually two different relative pronouns called "ko" - the first (ko1) is in the Group I noun class and is used with singular nouns; the second (ko2) is in the Group III noun class and is used with plural nouns - the plural forms of nouns from either "nga," "ngi," or "ngal" use ko2 when referring to large things. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.
